auto.uses: lattice pitch first, dot diameter as fallback

tunable_parameters.name: threshold
tunable_parameters.effect: Lower keeps more faint needles; higher reduces false positives.

tunable_parameters.name: image_scale
tunable_parameters.effect: Advanced override. Normal operation maps 20x/40x/60x to exact model scales 2.0/1.0/0.6667.

tunable_parameters.name: input_magnification
tunable_parameters.effect: When provided, image_scale is trained_magnification / input_magnification.

tunable_parameters.name: target_pitch_px
tunable_parameters.effect: Expected lattice pitch at model scale; auto-scale uses target_pitch_px / estimated_pitch_px.

tunable_parameters.name: target_dot_diameter_px
tunable_parameters.effect: Expected dot diameter at model scale; used when pitch cannot be estimated.

tunable_parameters.name: patch_size
tunable_parameters.effect: Sliding-window tile size for model inference.

tunable_parameters.name: overlap
tunable_parameters.effect: Sliding-window overlap. Higher values are smoother but slower.

tunable_parameters.name: channel_mode
tunable_parameters.effect: Use one channel, the maximum across channels, or the sum across channels.

tunable_parameters.name: channel
tunable_parameters.effect: Zero-based TIFF page or band used for inference.
